decisions.decision: Regenerate all production request/pack identities from post-I09-0056 protected inputs and treat all earlier I09-0048 and I09-0056 acceptance identities as non-reusable evidence only.
decisions.rationale: The compiler freshness model binds exact heads, Issue snapshot, project state, ledger and KDs; prerequisite head drift invalidates prior production identities.

decisions.decision: Use the protected compiler-backed stager as the only writer of generated context bytes to the Git object database, then pass only its returned Git blob SHA unchanged to the existing publisher.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the trusted boundary: generated bytes are reconstructed from authoritative inputs inside protected automation rather than uploaded or manually injected by the client.

decisions.decision: Merge production PR #36 only after independently checking one-parent ancestry, one-file scoped diff, exact candidate CI, trusted strict bootstrap status, empty review threads, exact main CAS and unchanged ruleset.
decisions.rationale: Publisher success alone is not merge authority.

decisions.decision: Keep derived context non-authoritative and preserve current-state/CI/ownership/ruleset/gate authority exactly as encoded by the pack and compiler contracts.
decisions.rationale: A deterministic context pack is a derived convenience artifact, not a control-plane source of truth.

decisions.decision: Rematerialize state/current.json before Issue closure with the lifecycle observed while #48 is still claimed, and close/remove claimed only after the protected control bookkeeping merge and post-merge CI succeed.
decisions.rationale: This matches existing protected lifecycle ordering and avoids making the candidate state predict a GitHub mutation that has not yet occurred.
